title: General Relativity via differential forms -- explorations in Plebanski's Formalism for GR
summary: This thesis studies general relativity (GR) using chiral formulations, which take advantage of the decomposition of the four-dimensional Lorentz group into self-dual and anti-self-dual sectors. Within this framework, GR can be expressed using Plebanski's formulation, where the basic variables are triples of 2-forms rather than a metric, or alternatively through pure connection approaches. These viewpoints expose additional structure in Einstein's equations (EEs) and offer new analytical and numerical tools.
